title: Windows Acceptance Import Semantics
objective: Validate Windows release artifacts using per-file PE import semantics while preserving static-CRT and security gates

oracles: Production embedded-node-addon records require delayed-only node.exe imports
Final Windows artifacts reject all MSVC runtime DLL imports

handoff.summary: Final artifact acceptance now proves Windows PE imports per production file rather than trusting an aggregate dependency name. Every embedded-node-addon must delay-load node.exe and must not import it eagerly; exactly one executable-template must use the production sea/node-template label and must not import node.exe. Labels and dependencies are unique under Windows case folding, and the aggregate dependency set is recomputed exactly from canonical per-file ordinary and delayed imports before node.exe receives its narrow contextual allowance. MSVCP140.dll, VCRUNTIME140.dll, and VCRUNTIME140_1.dll remain forbidden. Adversarial report-shaped tests cover eager, missing, mixed, cross-addon, forged aggregate, absent/duplicate/mislabeled/wrong-role template, and case-fold duplicate evidence while the complete acceptance suite preserves archive checksum, ZIP security, license, metadata, and signing gates. Independent source review approved exact f92e0b8edb4afca2b2cebba72cd63f3b88e00593. The exact focused suite passes 20/20 under official Node 26.7.0 on both Linux x64 and native Windows x64.
risks: This is source validation authority, not a final Windows artifact receipt. The frozen Windows candidate must still be rebuilt with the separate static-CRT policy and pass full archive acceptance.

The initial default pnpm test:changed compared with an older origin/main, selected 178 inherited release and mathematics files, then failed unrelated production-kernel, optional-native-capability, timing, and concurrent-load tests in this fresh isolated worktree. The explicit task-base changed gate, claimed acceptance suite, architecture, portable, and strict gates all pass on exact f92e0b8.
The first architecture receipt failed because the fresh worktree had no generated dist tree; after pnpm build established it, the current architecture receipt passes.
next_steps: Build the final Windows static-CRT candidate, then run full artifact acceptance to prove both executables, every embedded addon, the exact aggregate dependency set, ZIP security, licenses, checksums, and unsigned publication metadata.
